title: Yellowed Buttery Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring buttery and aerated empanadas, perfect for a post-workout snack, made with 00-flour and halal-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This recipe is a delicious and satisfying treat.
instructions: Preheat the Dutch oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the 00-flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the melted butter to the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of ground beef in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas in the preheated Dutch oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
